Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

quesma otelbench · evaluates: OTelBench’s creator methodology verifies span names, parent-child relationships, valid trace IDs and context propagation rather than accepting code merely because it compiles.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.otelbench.functional-verification.v2

  • The example distinguishes separate user journeys; it does not establish a comprehensive reliability or production-readiness guarantee for every instrumented system.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

quesma otelbench · dataset size: The captured OTelBench methodology describes 23 OpenTelemetry instrumentation tasks across 11 programming languages, using small microservice codebases of around 300 lines for agents to edit and run in a terminal.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.otelbench.task-scope.v3

  • This is the January 2026 reported evaluation scope. The later README’s task list is retained separately and not forced to have the same count.
